about: Real-image evaluation set for background removal (docs/design/MATTE_EVAL.md). Images are NOT stored in the repo: they are downloaded from Wikimedia Commons (scaled thumbnails) and composited outside the repo; this file records every source, its licence and author, and the composite recipe. Run: node scripts/matte-eval.mjs <dataset-dir>.
